findings.evidence_ref: company/engineering/result.py:469 — int(data['developer_attempts_remaining']) when value is None; ai_platform/serde.py:47 — to_jsonable(None) returns None (key retained, not dropped)
findings.summary: from_mapping calls int(data['developer_attempts_remaining']) when the key is present with value None (JSON null), which raises TypeError; to_dict() on a result whose field is None serializes the key as null rather than omitting it, so any round-trip of a legacy result stored after this fix will crash on reload.

findings.evidence_ref: tests/test_company_engineering_execution.py:1855-1858 — legacy_data strips the key; no test round-trips a None result through to_dict+from_mapping
findings.summary: The new test exercises the absent-key path (legacy record before serialization) but not the null-value path (legacy result re-read after to_dict wrote null), leaving the crash in finding from-mapping-null-value-crashes uncaught by the suite.

findings.evidence_ref: grep output: only 2 files match developer_attempts_remaining across all .py files
findings.summary: The implementer's stated unresolved risk (callers of developer_attempts_remaining outside authorized paths) is not a real risk: a codebase-wide grep finds the field referenced only in company/engineering/result.py and tests/test_company_engineering_execution.py.
